definitions.gloss: bamboo cutter; person who gathers bamboo
definitions.explanation: A person whose occupation is cutting and gathering bamboo. Almost always encountered today in the title of the classical tale {竹取物語|たけとりものがたり} ('The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter').

examples.japanese: {竹取物語|たけとりものがたり}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read 'The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter.'

examples.japanese: {竹取物語|たけとりものがたり}は、{日本|にほん}{最古|さいこ}の{物語|ものがたり}とされている。
examples.english: 'The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter' is considered the oldest narrative tale in Japan.

notes:
Compound of {竹|たけ} (bamboo) + {取|と}り (taking, gathering; from the verb {取|と}る).

CULTURAL NOTE:
In modern Japanese the word is almost never used in its literal occupational sense; it survives because of {竹取物語|たけとりものがたり}, a 10th-century tale in which an old bamboo cutter finds a tiny princess (かぐや{姫|ひめ}) inside a glowing bamboo stalk. The story is widely taught in schools and adapted in film and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竹取物語|たけとりものがたり}: 'The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter'
- {竹取|たけとり}の{翁|おきな}: the old bamboo cutter (the tale's protagonist)
